why: The only scenario whose grading depends on content outside its own diff. It asserts the model investigated a REAL caller of slice_dictionary rather than pattern-matching the diff, so a real caller has to exist in BASE. Pinned to a commit, not a branch: expect.json grades an exact line, and a moving ref would let the premise drift out from under it. Fetched rather than vendored so the caller stays real code the scenario did not author; pr_root/ is the opposite case and is deliberately synthetic.
